text:
By Griffin Missant ,
3 hours ago
Unfortunately, Week 4 of the NFL season came with some serious injuries to big-name fantasy football options.
Malik Nabers and Tyreek Hill will both miss the rest of the season with leg injuries. On top of those, byes start in Week 5.
There are four teams on a bye this week: the Falcons, Bears, Packers, and Steelers. So players like Bijan Robinson, Josh Jacobs, and Rome Odunze are all unavailable.
With all of this transpiring, lineups can get dicey, and the waiver wire can run things. Here are our Week 5 half-PPR Flex rankings to help you manage your fantasy team.

F ANTASY LINEUP TIPS: Week 5 Start-Sit | Week 5 Busts | Week 5 Sleepers
Half-PPR flex rankings tips for Week 5 Half-PPR RB lineup advice: Week 5 Christian McCaffrey had 15 targets last time Mac Jones played, and that was with Ricky Pearsall playing. With no Pearsall or Jennings, CMC might get 20 targets. Breece Hall is my RB9 in Week 5 because of the matchup with Dallas, and Braelon Allen is likely to land on IR. Emari Demercado should see the RB1 role for the Arizona Cardinals with Trey Benson on IR. Rachaad White is someone to monitor as Bucky Irving is questionable for Week 5. Half-PPR WR lineup advice: Week 5 We are still awaiting Terry McLaurin's status for Week 5. He missed Week 4 and has not practiced, but he has not been deemed out. That is why he's not in the rankings. Garrett Wilson is my WR3 this week; what could go wrong there? Dallas simply allows offensive shootouts every week. Kendrick Bourne becomes an interesting desperation play with Ricky Pearsall and Jauan Jennings both out in Week 5. Half-PPR TE lineup advice: Week 5 Jake Tonges becomes an interesting play in Week 5 with all the pass catchers being injured for the Niners. David Njoku is questionable for Week 5. If he misses, Harold Fannin is a must-start. TOP FANTASY PICKUPS: Week 5 waiver wire
Who are the best Half-PPR flex Week 5 sleepers? Stefon Diggs, WR, New England Patriots: Diggs is coming off his best game of the season, where he caught 6 passes for 101 yards off of 7 targets. In Week 5, he takes on his former team in the Buffalo Bills. The game script should be there for a ton of passing, and NE still needs a WR1 to trust.
Blake Corum, RB, Los Angeles Rams: This is best if you are in a deeper league, but there is a real chance we see Corum get work in this game. Not only has he continued to look better, but SF is a shell of their team on a short week. The Rams might be up big in the second half and give Corum some nice garbage-time production.
Who are the top bust candidates in Half-PPR this week? Jacory Croskey-Merritt, RB, Washington Commanders: The Commanders' backfield is a mess right now. The coaches say Croskey-Merritt is the "most capable," but it's still a committee. On top of this, the match-up is not great as they take on the Chargers, who have allowed the third fewest fantasy points per game to the RB position.
Jerry Jeudy, WR, Cleveland Browns: With Cedric Tillman on IR, Jeudy might be a popular play this week. However, Dillon Gabriel is making his NFL debut against one of the most unconventional defenses in the league. Gabriel might start seeing ghosts in London.
